comments: I build AltCaption. The checker is free. Each flagged image has an optional button that drafts replacement alt text with AltCaption's AI generator. That part has 3 free drafts without an account, 2 more with a free account, then a $19/month plan. The checker does not run JavaScript, so images added in the browser after load are not scanned. There is no accessibility statement or ACT Rules report yet.
features: Paste a public page URL to list its images with a missing alt attribute, empty alt, generic text like "image" or "photo", long text, or alt text repeated on several images. Use the list to review WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content. Empty alt can be correct for decorative images. Free, no account. Scans the HTML the server returns, up to 250 images.
title: AltCaption image alt text checker
